## Extracting the data:

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
df = load_data()
```



## plotting the behavioral data:
```{r, fig.height=6,fig.width=8, message=F,warning=F}
plot_beh_data(df,NULL,F)

plot_beh_data_tog(df %>% filter(Trialtype == "Main"), NULL, F)

plot_beh_data_tog(df %>% mutate(subject = as.numeric(as.factor(subject))) %>% 
  filter(subject %in% 1:11) %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf") %>% drop_na(), 6, F)
```

## fit the standard model with meta-uncertainty and meta-bias
```{r}
model = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Emperical dataanalysis","hierarchical","Full_Heurestic.stan"))

# model = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Emperical dataanalysis","hierarchical","vectorized.stan"))


dd = df %>% 
  mutate(subject = as.numeric(as.factor(subject))) %>% 
  filter(ID != "Rasmus_2026_04_02") %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf") %>% drop_na() 


datastan = list(N = nrow(dd),
                S = length(unique(dd$ID)),
                S_id = as.numeric(as.factor(dd$ID)),
                a = dd$Y,
                a_vec = dd$Y,
                RT = dd$RT,
                D = dd$D,
                C = dd$Confidence,
                X = dd$X * dd$D,
                XD = dd$X,
                minRT = min(dd$RT),
                ACC = dd$Correct,
                interval = dd$interval)

pf = model$pathfinder(data = datastan, num_threads = 4, psis_resample = F, calculate_lp = F)


fit <-model$sample(
  data = datastan,
  refresh = 10,
  iter_sampling = 500,
  iter_warmup = 500,
  adapt_delta = 0.95,
  max_treedepth = 12,
  init  = pf,
  parallel_chains = 4)


fit$save_object(here::here("Experimental analysis","Heurestic models","saved models","saved models hier",paste0("fit_finalheu_lapse.rds")))

```


```{r}
fit_hier <- readRDS(here::here("Experimental analysis","Heurestic models","saved models","saved models hier","fit_finalheu_lapse.rds"))
```


```{r, fig.width=16,fig.height=12}
dia_hier(fit_hier, dd)
```
